attribution.note: Marcus states both propositions directly in his own commentary.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves the production difficulty and retrospective majority claims without adding a forecast.

contract.note: Treating preliminary work as experiments or pilots and requiring a majority of deployment efforts is an ordinary reading. The birthday context reasonably bounds the period, although Marcus supplied no formal denominator.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous research identifies hallucinations and mitigation limitations as production barriers. It supports difficulty but does not establish how much deployment work remained preliminary.
Dated secondary reporting describes a small May–July 2023 survey. Organization-level experimentation and production shares cannot establish the share of deployment efforts across the target period.
The executive survey concerns broader AI and GenAI and counts leaders, not LLM projects. Its overlapping categories and unspecified field dates limit its relevance to the majority claim.

reviews.rationale: The packet supports recurring production barriers but lacks a representative denominator showing that most LLM deployment efforts remained preliminary. Reports of some production adoption do not contradict a majority-preliminary claim. The combined observation remains unresolved.
